appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.hint: Choose how axomail looks. "System" follows your operating system's light or dark setting.

autoconfig.foundVia: Settings found via {source}. Review them below.
autoconfig.notFound: No settings found automatically. Enter them below.
autoconfig.unavailable: Automatic search needs the desktop app. Enter the settings below.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Choose the language axomail uses. "System default" follows your operating system's language.
language.statusUnavailable: Changing the language needs the desktop app; it is unavailable in the browser preview.

pgp.title: OpenPGP encryption
pgp.hint: Sign and encrypt mail with OpenPGP. Your secret keys are held in the operating-system keychain, never in the database.
pgp.noOwnKeys: No keys yet. Generate one to start signing and receiving encrypted mail.
pgp.noRecipientKeys: No recipient keys yet. Import a contact's public key to encrypt to them.
pgp.signHint: Add an OpenPGP signature recipients can verify.
pgp.encryptHint: Encrypt so only the recipients can read it.
pgp.encryptUnavailable: Encryption needs a public key for every recipient. Missing: {missing}

badge.signedMismatch: Signed, but not by the sender
badge.needsPassphrase: Enter your key passphrase to decrypt

dialog.title: Advanced search
dialog.name: Name
dialog.unavailable: Advanced search needs the desktop app; it is unavailable in the browser preview.

compose.templateUnavailable: Saving a template needs the desktop app; it is unavailable in the browser preview.

bar.requested: The sender requested a read receipt.
bar.failed: Could not send the read receipt.
bar.unavailable: Sending a receipt needs the desktop app.

settings.title: Read receipts
settings.hint: Choose how axomail responds when a sender asks for a read receipt (a message disposition notification).
settings.onlyWhenAddressed: Only when the message is addressed to me
settings.statusUnavailable: Changing read-receipt settings needs the desktop app; it is unavailable in the browser preview.

templates.title: Templates
templates.empty: No templates yet. Use “Save as template” in the composer to create one.
templates.unavailable: Templates need the desktop app; they are unavailable in the browser preview.

folderView.label: Folder view
folderView.favoritesEmptyHint: Open a folder's menu and choose "Add to Favorites".

retention.title: Message retention
retention.hint: Limit how much mail is kept in this folder. Starred messages are always kept.
retention.modeByCount: Keep a maximum number of messages
retention.actionHint: "Move to Trash" relocates over-limit messages to Trash — never a permanent server delete. "Remove the local copy only" drops the cached body; nothing leaves the server and it is re-fetched on demand.
retention.saveFailed: Could not save the retention policy.
retention.applied: Retention applied: {trashed} moved to Trash, {purged} local copies removed.
retention.unavailable: Retention needs the desktop app; it is unavailable in the browser preview.
